description:

Want to know more? Meet our presenter:

Shauna Dillavou is the CEO of Brightlines, a doxxing prevention company. Shauna was trained in security by the US intelligence community, taking what she was taught to support the security of activists, journalists, academics, and scientists for the last 15 years. She has advised on the security of groups in the US, the Former Soviet Union, and throughout Asia, and has trained in human-centered design and trauma-informed service delivery.

title: Protect our trans siblings! No cuts to Medicaid and SNAP!
description:
Late Wednesday night the U.S. House of Representatives passed HR 1, a spending bill that would prohibit transgender people of any age from accessing gender-affirming care through Medicaid and the Children’s Health Insurance Program (CHIP). This impacts 276,000+ transgender people currently enrolled in Medicaid. That’s 1 in 5 trans adults. 

The bill also contains the huge tax cuts for the wealthiest Americans while making the largest cuts to Medicaid and SNAP - ever. This legislation will rip healthcare and food from our families to line the pockets of the mega-rich. 

Now the bill moves to the Senate for a vote. It’s a bad bill period. But for the LGBTQIA+ community it is imperative that the discriminatory and dangerous language targeting trans and non-binary people is removed. By eliminating coverage for gender-affirming care, the bill not only undermines the health and dignity of transgender Americans but also sets a dangerous precedent for healthcare discrimination. 

Billionaires who will never need to rely on Medicaid want to cut it to give themselves tax breaks. We should make healthcare better for everyone, not take it away. Protecting access to comprehensive, inclusive healthcare must remain a national priority. 

Your Senators need to hear from you immediately that we won’t stand for any cuts to gender affirming care, Medicaid, and SNAP!

Big events with thousands of people are great. But we also need local, more frequent rallies that show locals that they're not alone in this fight.

**When we realized the ICE was abducting people appearing at U.S. Immigration Court, we decided it would be the perfect place for an ICE-specific RhRR!**

Every Tuesday @ 7:30 am, we'll gather on the south west corner where 7th Ave, Van Buren, and Grand meet, right in front of the Social Security Administration office, which also serves as U.S. Immigration Court.

**STAY ON THE SIDEWALK**! It's public property and we've a right to be there. Be sure you **DO NOT BLOCK** access to the building—that means cars as well as people.

**Please make ICE-specific signs**, as we're here to show the busy morning commuters that they are not alone, the ICE agents that We The People care about due process for everyone, and those before the court that we support them. Because no human is illegal.

Spread the word. Come join us. All the details you need are at [RhRR.us](https://rhrr.us).

Love this idea and want to start your own Rush-hour Resistance Rally in your area? Groovy! **[Let's make that happen!](https://rhrr.us/#start-your-own)
